hub.title: [DE] Settings
hub.subtitle: [DE] Company information, rules, system settings and data transfer.

access.title: [DE] Access settings
access.subtitle: [DE] Decide what employees can see on their home page, in their account and in the calendar.
access.scopeNotice: [DE] Access settings only restrict users with the Employee access type; Account owners, Administrators and HR users are not affected. Changes take effect as soon as they are saved.
access.readOnly: [DE] You can view access settings but are not allowed to change them.
access.loadError: [DE] Access settings could not be loaded.
access.saveError: [DE] Access settings could not be saved.

showOrgInfo.label: [DE] Employee and unit information
showOrgInfo.help: [DE] Information about units (unit, manager, team) is visible to employees on the home page.

showUpcomingLeaves.label: [DE] Upcoming leave
showUpcomingLeaves.help: [DE] People who will be on leave are listed on the home page. The leave type is not shown.

showUpcomingBirthdays.label: [DE] Upcoming birthdays
showUpcomingBirthdays.help: [DE] Employees see their colleagues' upcoming birthdays on the home page.

showEventCalendar.label: [DE] Event calendar
showEventCalendar.help: [DE] Meetings and similar events added in the app are listed on the home page.

showFiles.label: [DE] Files
showFiles.help: [DE] Employees can see the files on their own profile.

showAssets.label: [DE] Assets
showAssets.help: [DE] Employees can see the assets assigned to them.

showWorkPhoneNumbers.label: [DE] Employees' phone numbers
showWorkPhoneNumbers.help: [DE] If a work phone is set, it is visible to other employees.

showOrgChart.label: [DE] Org chart
showOrgChart.help: [DE] The org chart under Employees is opened to employees.

showCustomFields.label: [DE] Custom fields
showCustomFields.help: [DE] Unit authorized users can see custom fields on employee profiles. Employees cannot.

showCalendarMenu.label: [DE] Calendar menu
showCalendarMenu.help: [DE] Calendar is shown in the left menu.

showAllLeavesInCalendar.label: [DE] All leave in the calendar
showAllLeavesInCalendar.help: [DE] When off, employees only see leave in their own department; when on, they see leave across the whole company. Only "on leave" is shown, never the leave type.

supportAccess.title: [DE] Support access
supportAccess.subtitle: [DE] Approve or revoke requests from the Sense support team to access your company account.
supportAccess.privacyTitle: [DE] Your data stays under your control
supportAccess.privacyText: [DE] Sense staff cannot access your company's data without a time-limited access grant that you approve. An approved grant closes automatically when it expires, can be revoked at any time, and every action is recorded in the audit log.
supportAccess.approveConfirm: [DE] Approve time-limited support access for {{requester}}? Access stays valid until it expires or you revoke it.
supportAccess.revokeConfirm: [DE] Revoke this support access? Any ongoing session will be closed.
supportAccess.actionError: [DE] The action could not be completed.
supportAccess.loadError: [DE] Support access requests could not be loaded.

customFields.title: [DE] Custom fields
customFields.subtitle: [DE] Manage the custom field definitions shown on employee cards.

fields.keyHint: [DE] Lowercase letters, digits and underscores; must start with a letter. Cannot be changed after creation.
fields.keyImmutable: [DE] The key cannot be changed after creation.
fields.keyInvalid: [DE] The key must start with a lowercase letter and contain only lowercase letters, digits and underscores.
fields.name: [DE] Name
fields.dataTypeImmutable: [DE] The data type cannot be changed after creation.
fields.optionsHint: [DE] Type a value and press Enter to add an option.
fields.optionsRequired: [DE] Select-type fields require at least one option.
fields.isEmployeeEditable: [DE] Employee can edit from their own card
fields.isEmployeeEditableHint: [DE] When on, the employee may edit this field from their own card (self-service).
fields.employeeEditRequiresApprovalHint: [DE] For now the change is applied directly; an approval flow will be added in a later package.
fields.isSensitiveHint: [DE] Only callers with 'View sensitive fields' can see/change the value.
